newsitem.title: USA: Hecla Mining sees Q3 charge from mine.
newsitem.headline: Hecla Mining sees Q3 charge from mine.

text.p: Hecla Mining Co said on Thursday it will post third quarter charges of $7.7 million for write-down of its American Girl Joint Venture and an additional reclamation charge of $200,000 to $300,000.
Hecla owns 47 percent of the American Girl venture and MK Gold Co owns the remainder, the company said.

The two companies plan to suspend operations at the American Girl mine in Imperial County, Calif. Mining and milling activities will continue until the accessible underground and open-pit ores are extracted, Hecla said.
